data.standardized_narrative: Unable to reliably extract a gross prior-year claims reserves balance or a gross prior-year development amount from the provided scanned pages. The PDF images contain claims development tables and balance sheet lines, but the scanned resolution/rotation and overlapping figures prevented confident identification of the definitive gross 'Claims outstanding' closing balance for 31 December 2014 (opening at 1 Jan 2015) and a gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure. Gross written premium for the year is visible and recorded below.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as scanned images with rotation and low legibility. I could identify the gross premiums written (2015) on the income statement (approximately GBP 244.78m) but could not confidently read the Balance Sheet liability line labelled 'Claims outstanding' in the prior-year (2014) comparative column required for 'opening_reserves_gbp_m'. The claims development (triangle) tables are present but not legible enough to extract reliable numeric cells for a gross prior-year development computation. Therefore opening reserves and prior-year development are set to null. If higher-resolution or native-text PDF is supplied I can extract precise figures and fill all fields. Where a gross prior-year movement (Insurance liabilities column) is available it should be used; none could be unambiguously located in these images.
